title: 0.7.9 Parcels
source_identity_note: Final release source and artifacts have not yet been frozen and accepted. SOURCE-REVISION.txt, artifact-manifest.json, the release tag and subsequent acceptance evidence must identify the exact same committed source. The source record cannot contain its own future commit identity.

development_verification.scope: Focused synthetic and bounded real-block checks on development source; the document records an aggregate timeout, a subsequently rerun graph test, and untested areas. This does not establish final-source or final-artifact acceptance.

pending_release_gates: Commit the final source and record the required source, regression and platform checks against that exact revision.

Build using the reviewed update channel and completed validated header baseline in a neutral workspace; independently audit all release artifacts, hashes, package contents, installer payload and build path privacy.
Exercise the exact packaged artifacts for startup, restart, native browser, representative indexing and installation; record successes, failures and skips.
Publish the approved prerelease and verify its tag, source revision and every downloaded artifact identity.

Prepare and authenticate the initial signed application and header update bundle against the exact published release and current independently verified feed sequences; promote and verify hosted manifests, actual downloads and a previous-client upgrade.
limits: Full-mainnet Parcel indexing and Live throughput, storage and resource requirements are not established by bounded fixtures.
Missing parent proof and unsupported proof cases remain pending; header-anchored processing is not full Bitcoin consensus or script validation.
Windows Authenticode, installation and SmartScreen acceptance require separate evidence.
